minima: For each cardinality 0..16: exact minimum-distance condition, one complete page (saved counts all <=256), first/middle/last distinct ranks and inverse-mask comparison, plus rank=count rejection.
conditions: Fifteen additional conditions: full, require/forbid vertex0, require/forbid shortest host class, require longest/both extreme classes, all eight-vertex subsets, distance budget9, require original vertices0/32, absent required source class, incompatible vertices/distances, reversed cardinality and negative budget.
marginals: Full family, shortest-host-class condition, and minimum-distance eight-vertex family. Counts are subsets containing each vertex/class once.
pagination: Saved fixed cardinality total 12,870 is the known combinatorial binomial(16,8), not a distance result. Query at-end and beyond-end pages; a zero mask is outside cardinality8.
custody: Every request/response/latest caches/work retained before next call. Complete compact result checkpointed before publication; no old metric or support construction replay.
output: If complete reader exceeds a checkpoint artifact limit, split its exact serialized text before any provider call and retain ordered chunk manifest; never rerun the reader.
